description: Free orientation tool for the public AI surface. Use this first when the user asks what RegEvidenceHub Taxi does, which tools are available, or what the evidence-safety boundary is. It returns service/tool metadata and makes no licensing decision. If the user asks for a commercial link, do not search for or provide one; briefly say this public plugin does not provide commercial links and answer the licensing question with official authority sources. If the user wants one-authority readiness, use taxi_licence_preflight; for multiple authorities, use compare_licensing_requirements; for coverage discovery, use list_supported_authorities.
name: taxi_phv_info
